<infobox>
  <title source="title1">
    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
  </title>
  <image source="image1">
    <caption source="caption1"/>
  </image>
  <data source="deployment_cost">
    <label>Deployment Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{{deployment_cost}}}</span></format>
  </data>
  <data source="upgrade_levels">
    <label>Upgrade Levels</label>
  </data>
  <data source="total_cost">
    <label>Total Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{{total_cost}}}</span></format>
  </data>
  <data source="tower_type">
    <label>Tower Type</label>
  </data>
  <group>
    <header>Attack Stats</header>
    <data source="attack_type">
      <label>Attack Type </label>
    </data>
    <data source="damage">
      <label>Damage</label>
    </data>
    <data source="spa_(second_per_attack)">
      <label>SPA (Second Per Attack)</label>
    </data>
    <data source="range">
      <label>Range</label>
    </data>
  </group>
</infobox>
<noinclude>
Example usage:
<pre>

  | title1=Example

  | image1=Example

  | caption1=Example

  | deployment_cost=Example

  | upgrade_levels=Example

  | total_cost=Example

  | tower_type=Example

  | attack_type=Example

  | damage=Example

  | spa_(second_per_attack)=Example

  | range=Example

}}
</pre>
